source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. No school name is printed. Printed header: 2nd Term Examination, Class: VII, Subject: Science, Time: 2Hrs, Marks: 80; footer 'Std7/Science/7th Feb 2025/73'. Although the file is listed on icseboard.org under class 8 / biology, the paper itself prints Class VII, so this pack is filed as class 7. examYear 2025 is from the printed footer date (7th Feb 2025). The Science paper has Section A Biology (25 Marks), Section B Chemistry (30 Marks) and Section C Physics (25 Marks); one pack is built per section. The 80 marks and 2 hours apply to the whole Science paper. Group totals are kept as one entry (never split). Student ticks/handwriting on the scan are ignored. No answer key is printed. This pack holds Section C (Physics), 25 marks; listed marks total 25. No Q13 is printed (the paper goes from Q12 to Q14). Q14 prints a group total [6] for five MCQs; kept as printed. Q18 i) and ii) carry 3½ marks each and are kept together as one 7-mark entry.

questions.text:
Observe and explain :
A mobile phone is placed in a glass bell jar as shown in the figure below. When the phone starts ringing, it is heard loudly outside the jar. The air from the glass jar is then pumped out through a tube as shown in the image.
(a) What will be your observation as the mobile phone rings in the glass jar while the air is slowly being pumped out of it?
(b) Explain your answer to part (a)
(c) Through which of the mediums does sound travel the fastest?

questions.text:
Numericals [Show all your calculations and workings] :
i) A man claps his hand at echo point in Mahableshwar and hears the echo of his clap after 4 seconds. If the speed of sound in his given environment was 330m/s, calculate the distance of the mountain from the man.

Numericals [Show all your calculations and workings] :
ii) A dolphin sends ultrasonic waves as it swims through the ocean. These waves are reflected from a block of ice in its path. If the ultrasonic sound wave takes 6 seconds to travel from the dolphin to the ice block and back, what is the distance at which the block of ice floats? (If the speed of sound water is 1500m/s).

SONAR is a device. What does the word SONAR stand for?
a) State one use of the SONAR and explain how it works.
